summary: Join our M&E for Public Health training to learn vital strategies for assessing and enhancing health interventions. Elevate your impact in public health.
lede: M&E for public health programs gives you a structured way to collect, analyze, and use data to track intervention progress and measure health outcomes. You will learn to build M&E plans, define SMART epidemiological indicators, develop Performance Indicator Reference Sheets, and apply a Theory of Change. The course also covers Data Quality Assessments, Routine Health Information Systems, digital data collection workflows, and health impact dashboards. Practical techniques for AI-assisted data cleaning, mobile health data integration, and stakeholder reporting help you turn incomplete field data into evidence that supports adaptive, accountable programs.
audienceIntro: This comprehensive training is structured for professionals responsible for tracking, evaluating, and reporting on health interventions across diverse operational contexts.
modules: Designing the Theory of Change and LogFrame
Data Collection and Digital Health Systems
Ensuring Data Quality in Health Programs
prerequisites: Participants should have a working knowledge of basic public health concepts and routine data collection processes. No advanced statistical coding or programming experience is required. We recommend bringing a current project or intervention idea to use as a baseline for the practical LogFrame and indicator design exercises.
